facts.fact: The state pays for the 201-site Mobilis 4G universal service programme, more than DZD 27.3 billion (about USD 204 million per Algérie Eco), through the fund d'appui du service universel (set up by decree 18-247 of 2018 as cited elsewhere), under a cahier des charges approved by arrêté of 4 August 2026; the document says it is not Mobilis's own investment.
facts.system: Fonds d'appui du service universel de la poste et du service universel des communications électroniques

systems.system: Fonds d'appui du service universel de la poste et du service universel des communications électroniques
systems.owner: Commission multisectorielle de gestion du fonds; ARPCE runs the tender

note: The 27.3bn DA is a fund-financed programme amount with no budget year given, so no allocated fact.
